difficulty_reason: The authors combine PBW bounds in universal enveloping algebras, central characters and Gelfand-Tsetlin subalgebras to construct representation-theoretic projectors, then implement Lie-algebra actions as efficient circuit transformations. The nonroutine connection between projector diversity and metapolynomial circuit size yields all four explicit complexity bounds.
